WoWFA Forever 1.0.0-rc28 (test build, built by wowfa2 CI).

NPC names: a second pass that checked the MEANING of every name, not only the word order. 515 names corrected (for example cliff lurker is now «کمین‌گر صخره», death siren is «سیرن مرگ», magma totem is «توتم ماگما»). One vocabulary everywhere: stalker, lurker, totem, warlock, Venture Co., elder, siren, scourge. 97 more names were unified across all shards. The same names inside quest and spell texts follow the change.
Includes rc7 to rc27.
